content.page9_passage:
A. 大文喜欢春天，春天的时候，大文家的院子很漂亮，有很多颜色的花，红色的、白色的，也有黄色的。东明最喜欢夏天，夏天到了，天气变热了，他可以游泳也可以打球。

B. 心美最喜欢的是秋天，她的生日是九月三十号，她生日的时候，秋天快到了。秋天的天气很舒服，不冷也不热，秋天的树叶变黄了，可是草地还是绿色的。张莉不喜欢夏天也不喜欢冬天，她觉得夏天太热了，冬天太冷了，她喜欢春天，她觉得春天的花最漂亮。

lessonDialogue.speaker: 大文
lessonDialogue.zh: 你看！树叶变黄了，秋天快到了。
lessonDialogue.pinyin: nǐ kàn shù yè biàn huáng le qiū tiān kuài dào le
lessonDialogue.en: Look! The leaves have turned yellow. Autumn is almost here.

lessonDialogue.speaker: 张莉
lessonDialogue.pinyin: kě shì cǎo hái shì lǜ sè de
lessonDialogue.en: But the grass is still green.

lessonDialogue.speaker: 心美
lessonDialogue.zh: 秋天天气很好。我觉得很舒服。
lessonDialogue.pinyin: qiū tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo wǒ jué de hěn shū fu
lessonDialogue.en: The weather is very nice in autumn. I feel very comfortable.

lessonDialogue.speaker: 大文
lessonDialogue.zh: 春天的时候，我们家院子有很多颜色的花，红色的、白色的都有。
lessonDialogue.pinyin: chūn tiān de shí hou wǒ men jiā yuàn zi yǒu hěn duō yán sè de huā hóng sè de bái sè de dōu yǒu
lessonDialogue.en: In spring, our yard has flowers of many colors, including red and white.

lessonDialogue.speaker: 心美
lessonDialogue.zh: 我觉得红色的花最漂亮。
lessonDialogue.pinyin: wǒ jué de hóng sè de huā zuì piào liang
lessonDialogue.en: I think red flowers are the prettiest.

_editingGuide.purpose: Edit answerKeys to change the expected answers. The HTML reconstructs keys into quiz questions when loading.
_editingGuide.page1_listening: Unverified without Chapter 5 Quiz1 recording; map circle, triangle and square to zero-based vocabulary positions for each group.
_editingGuide.page1_pictures: One zero-based picture choice per question.
_editingGuide.page2_fill: Rows correspond to Section A/B, columns to question order. Answers are vocabulary strings from the word bank.
_editingGuide.page4_comprehension: Zero-based selected option index for each question.
_editingGuide.page6_matching: Pinyin answer strings in order of the characters in page6_matches.
_editingGuide.page6_radicals: Common-component answer strings in question order; these are collected for teacher review (not auto-graded).
_editingGuide.page7_writing: Character answer arrays for each writing sentence, in blank order.
_editingGuide.page8_fill: Vocabulary strings for each group and sentence.
_editingGuide.page9_true_false: true or false for each comprehension statement.

pageMapping.page1: C5-1/C5-2 listen and circle + six picture items
pageMapping.page9: C5-8 two reading passages, eight true/false questions

cautions: Chapter 5 MP3 recordings were not attached, so pages 1, 3, 5 listening keys are unknown and intentionally left empty or null.
The original workbook does not include answer keys for its reading-based questions; non-audio answers are derived from the reading or question context.
Some Quiz 2 reading-based questions refer to a separate lesson text not included in this workbook; verify the selections against the textbook.
The existing index.html was not available for runtime testing; the JSON preserves its field structure.
The C5-6 first writing-row final phonetic clue is shí in the PDF, yielding an awkward phrase; preserved the printed clue and answer rather than silently rewriting the exercise.
Page 4 questions 3 and 5 are answered by the supplied Chapter 5 lesson dialogue.
